question.text: Under PMS, the Investment Policy Statement and Strategic Asset Allocation provide for:

answer.text: Portfolio rebalancing schedules and periodic rebalancing to maintain target allocations

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series XXI-A workbook (pages 123 and 131), the IPS may include portfolio rebalancing schedules, and Strategic Asset Allocation involves periodically rebalancing the portfolio to maintain the target allocation. The Trap: Crash-only or tax-driven rebalancing are not what the IPS/SAA framework defines; never rebalancing contradicts SAA discipline. Note: Source: NISM Series XXI-A workbook, pages 123 and 131.
